label: I read the newspaper in the morning.

translations.en: I read the newspaper in the morning.
translations.id: Saya membaca surat kabar pada pagi hari.
translations.ja: 私は朝に新聞を読みます。

label: She reads a book at night.

translations.en: She reads a book at night.
translations.id: Dia membaca buku pada malam hari.
translations.ja: 彼女は夜に本を読みます。

label: The newspaper is on the table.

translations.en: The newspaper is on the table.
translations.de: Die Zeitung liegt auf dem Tisch.
translations.id: Surat kabar itu ada di atas meja.
translations.ja: 新聞はテーブルの上にあります。

label: I buy a newspaper at the station.

translations.en: I buy a newspaper at the station.
translations.de: Ich kaufe am Bahnhof eine Zeitung.
translations.id: Saya membeli surat kabar di stasiun.
translations.ja: 私は駅で新聞を買います。
